subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements: Some kites are hats. No hat is a ant. 

Conclusion (II): Some Kites are ants. 

Conclusion (II): Some hats are kites.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31fda017a191241cc85b35d5ae16b67a8b175be517a87a95d0180745714f8c11.png] 

Conclusion (II): Some Kites are ants. - False ( As their is no direct relation between Kites and ants may be it is posssible but not definite. Hence, it is false.

Conclusion (II): Some hats are kites. - True (Some kites are hats means some hats are kites is true)

Only conclusion (II) follows

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
